quote: A true conception of the relation of the sexes will not admit of conqueror and conquered; it knows of but one great thing: to give of one’s self boundlessly, in order to find one’s self richer, deeper, better. That alone can fill the emptiness, and transform the tragedy of woman’s emancipation into joy, limitless joy.
source: Emma Goldman, The Tragedy of Woman’s Emancipation, the closing sentences, Anarchism and Other Essays (1910)
